theater: 花剌子模河三角洲與運河鹽沼

battle.name: 哈瓦利吉派叛亂
battle.theater: 花剌子模河三角洲與運河鹽沼
battle.brief: 公元八六六年，哈瓦利吉派伊巴德社群在中亞花剌子模河三角洲起兵，席捲運河村社與鹽沼；八七〇年巴士拉的伊巴德領袖阿布·貝克爾·伊本·哈拉勒應召北上接掌旗幄，隨後陣亡於一次河戰，起義終為總督軍平定。卡面的斯巴達長矛是兩米木杆長矛的祖型，鐵鏃配銅尾套，正是三角洲民兵結陣所用的形制。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰的兩方在結構上極不對稱。朝廷一方是阿拔斯王朝在呼羅珊以北的前沿總督區——花剌子模：名義上由薩馬拉的哈里發直接委任，實際由世襲的阿拉伯裔總督家族統治，後世稱為阿弗拉西亞比德；總督自備的常備軍以阿拉伯部族騎兵為骨幹，另從三角洲城鄉徵發花剌子模步兵與弓手，更高的支配者是哈里發與巴格達的權臣。本役爆發時哈里發為穆塔維克爾，實權操在穆瓦法克與突斯人兄弟手中，前線的調兵與撥餉都沿這條鏈條層層轉手。叛方是哈瓦利吉派中的伊巴德派社群：花剌子模河下游的波斯裔改宗者、運河兩岸的村社與城鎮商戶，多年信奉伊巴德派教法，形成自己的清真寺、宣教網絡與互助組織，由奈基卜與穆瓦利主持；平日是稅戶兼民兵，舉兵之後則沒有國家、沒有常備軍、沒有糧餉，武器靠自備與奪取。其思想與組織上的外援來自巴士拉的伊巴德派領袖團體、突尼斯的伊馬目國與地中海的澤爾巴島社群，組成一個橫跨數千里的信仰網絡。朝廷有編制、有經費、有攻城器械，叛方有的只是社群動員力與對三角洲水網的熟悉——這場戰爭的全部形勢，都寫在這個對比裡。
countriesEn: The two sides were structurally unequal in every respect. On the government side stood the Abbasid Caliphate's frontier governorship north of Khurasan, Khwarazm: nominally a province appointed directly by the caliph in Samarra, but in practice held by a hereditary dynasty of Arab governors, later called the Afrasiabids. The governor's own standing army had Arab tribal cavalry as its backbone, supplemented by Khwarazmian infantry and archers levied from the towns and villages of the delta; above them stood the caliph in Samarra and the amirs in Baghdad. When this war broke out the caliph was al-Mutawakkil, while effective power lay with al-Muwaffaq and the Tulunid brothers, so every dispatch of men and money to the front had to pass down that chain of command. On the insurgents' side were the Ibadi communities of the Kharijite sect: Persian-speaking converts in the lower Khwarazm delta, village communities along the canals and the traders of the small towns, who had observed Ibadi religious law for years and had built their own mosques, preaching networks and mutual-aid institutions under na'ibs and muwalis. In peacetime they were taxpaying subjects and part-time militia; once they rose they had no state, no standing army, no pay, and their weapons were their own or seized in battle. Ideological and organisational backing came from the Ibadi leadership of Basra, from the Ibadi imamate of Tahert in North Africa and from the Ibadi communities of the island of Djerba, a web of faith that stretched thousands of kilometres. The court side had order, money and machines; the insurgents had only communal mobilisation and a working knowledge of the delta's waterways — and the whole shape of the war is written into that contrast.
people: 留下姓名的有兩組。朝廷一方最關鍵的是花剌子模總督安努什爾萬·伊本·穆罕默德，阿弗拉西亞比德家族的統治者，在位約二十餘年，以治軍嚴整、倚重阿拉伯部族騎兵著稱；這場起義正是在他總督任內平定。文獻對他的記載集中在兩點：一是他以鎮壓「退教者」自任，向哈里發陳請協剿而把戰局留在自己手上，二是即便在起義席捲三角洲的數年裡，主要城邑的稅收與徵兵仍未脫離總督府控制。哈里發穆塔維克爾在位，軍國實權由哈里發特使穆瓦法克及其子阿布·阿巴斯，以及駐埃及與敍利亞的突斯人兄弟艾哈邁德·伊本·圖倫、烏馬爾·伊本·圖倫左右；花剌子模防務的歸屬，正是他們與總督府角力的一枚棋子。叛方最重要的人物是阿布·貝克爾·伊本·哈拉勒，巴士拉的伊巴德派領袖，自九世紀初年起在巴士拉主持反對派社群的教法與訴訟；後世編年一致認為，他在起義後期應花剌子模伊巴德社群的邀請北上，於八七〇年抵達戰區並接掌旗幄，隨即在一次沿河的野戰中陣亡，他的死被伊巴德派史家視為起義崩解的關鍵。此外還有一批名字只以「某某之子」「某某的兄弟」的形式留在殘卷中，說明起義基層的指揮更多依血緣與村社關係，而非正式職銜。
peopleEn: Names survive in two groups. The most important figure on the government side was Anushirvan ibn Muhammad, the Khwarazmian governor of the Afrasiabid dynasty, who ruled for somewhat more than twenty years and was known for strict discipline and for leaning on Arab tribal cavalry; the revolt was put down during his term as governor. The record about him concentrates on two points: first, that he presented himself as a suppressor of apostates, petitioned the caliph for troops to help crush the rebels, yet kept the actual conduct of the war in his own hands; second, that even during the years the rising swept the delta, the taxes and the levies of the principal towns remained under his governorate's control. Al-Mutawakkil was caliph, but real authority lay with the caliphal amir al-Muwaffaq and his son al-Abbas, and with the Tulunid brothers Ahmad and Umar ibn Tulun, who held Egypt and Syria; the fate of Khwarazm's defences was one of the pieces they and the governor's office contested. The decisive figure among the insurgents was Abu Bakr ibn al-Khallal, leader of the Ibadi community of Basra, who had headed the legal and judicial life of the opposition communities there since the early ninth century; later chronicles agree that in the later phase of the rising he answered an invitation from the Ibadi communities of Khwarazm, travelled north, reached the theatre in 870 and took over the banner, only to be killed in a river battle; Ibadi historiography treats his death as the turning point at which the revolt fell apart. Other names survive only in the form of 'the son of such-and-such' or 'the brother of such-and-such', which shows that command among the rank-and-file followed blood and village ties rather than formal rank.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是希臘方陣步兵的標誌性兵器：兩米許的木杆，前端裝柳葉形鐵鏃，槍尾套著銅套，銅套既加固杆身，也讓士兵可以把長矛插進鬆土、用尾撐承重。它並沒有出現在九世紀的花剌子模；那裡步兵用的是同一技術譜系的長矛——木杆、鐵矛頭，無穗或窄穗，配小圓盾與皮甲。卡面標記的是這條譜系的祖型，而不是一件出土的實物。叛方民兵按伊巴德派社群的傳統裝備：長柄矛、投矛、復合反曲弓、小圓盾、柄部纏皮的短刀，以及鐮刀形的彎刀；防護多為鑲片皮甲或亞麻層甲，僅少數人著鎖子甲。作戰核心是三角洲的馬群與駱駝：伊巴德社群在運河村社飼養大量駱駝與馬匹，起義軍靠奪來的牲畜與自備舟艇在沼澤中轉進。朝廷一方的常備軍除上述輕裝外，還有環首長刀、鎖子甲與鱗甲的騎兵，裝備與薩馬拉禁軍同源，並備有弓弩、撞槌與投石一類攻城器械；總督府還在三角洲水道上維持一支小型船隊，用來巡邏運河、封鎖叛軍船隊並輸送糧秣。糧食靠駱駝隊沿鹹海東岸與阿姆河下游的驛道運入，再以船分運到運河沿線的軍鎮。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Dory, the signature arm of the Greek hoplite phalanx: a wooden shaft a little over two metres long, a leaf-shaped iron head at the front and a bronze socket at the butt, which both strengthened the shaft and let a soldier plant the spear in soft ground and rest its weight on the spike. It did not appear in ninth-century Khwarazm. The infantry there used spears of the same technological family: wooden shafts, iron heads, no flanges or narrow ones, carried with small round shields and leather armour. What the card marks is the archetype of that lineage, not an excavated artefact. The rebel militia followed the customary equipment of the Ibadi communities: long spears, javelins, composite recurved bows, small round shields, short knives with wrapped grips, and sickles of the mukhar type; protection was mostly lamellar leather or linen-layered armour, with only a few wearing mail. The real centre of their strength was the delta's herds and camels: the Ibadi communities kept large numbers of camels and horses in the canal villages, and the insurgents moved through the marshes on seized animals and their own boats. The government cavalry, beyond that light kit, carried ring-pommelled swords, mail and scale armour in the same tradition as the Samarra guards, and the column also brought composite bows, crossbows, ram and mangonel for siege work. The governorate maintained a small flotilla on the delta's waterways to patrol the canals, seal the insurgents' boats and move grain. Food came in by camel caravan along the tracks east of the Aral and along the lower reaches of the Oxus, then was distributed by boat to the garrisons on the canals.
tactics: 可以確定的作戰樣貌有三個層次。第一層是叛方的起事方式：起義不是從一座大城起，而是運河兩岸的村社同時響應，最初的行動是夜襲村鎮、稅站與總督府的小型分遣隊，奪馬、奪糧、奪兵器，隨即退入沼澤與水網地帶；伊巴德派社群熟悉每一條灌溉渠、每一處渡口，官軍兵力佔優的追擊往往無功而返，追兵一入沼澤便馬陷泥、人失道，縱有騎兵也只能沿固定的堤道行進。叛方在戰術上避免正面會戰，以游擊、襲營、切斷糧道為主，必要時在堤道與橋口設伏，或以拆毀堤壩、改變水道來淹斷追兵的路徑。第二層是攻城與反攻城：總督軍攻奪村社堡寨時使用撞槌與火油，多數堡寨僅有土坯圍牆與塔樓，抵抗能力有限；叛方則退守村社，利用泥牆、窄門與屋頂射孔逐段抵抗。第三層是季節：花剌子模的春汛與夏熱決定作戰季節，秋末冬初水落、地面硬化，適合騎兵遠征，鎮壓的高潮往往落在秋冬，起義方也趁農閒季節補充人手與牲畜。整體而言，這是一場以地形與社群動員對抗編制與器械的戰爭，官軍最終靠封鎖水網、逐堡清剿與處置叛方上層，把以水網為依托的游擊運動擠壓到幾個據點之內。
tacticsEn: Three layers of the fighting can be reconstructed with some confidence. The first is how the revolt began and fought: it did not start in a great city but in the canal villages, which rose together, the opening moves being night raids on hamlets, tax posts and small governorate detachments, seizing horses, grain and weapons, and then falling back into the marshes and the network of canals. The Ibadi communities knew every irrigation channel and every ford, so government columns with a decisive numerical advantage often returned empty-handed; once a pursuit entered the marsh the horses bogged down and the men lost their track, and even cavalry had to keep to the firm embankments. The insurgents avoided pitched battle, relying on harassment, camp attacks and the cutting of supply lines, and where they had to stand they chose the dikes and bridge heads to ambush, or they broke the embankments to flood the ground behind a pursuing column. The second layer is siege and counter-siege: when government troops took the village strongholds they used rams and fire, for most of these were earth-walled enclosures with a tower or two, of limited resistance; the defenders withdrew into the village and fought in sections behind mud walls, narrow gates and roof openings. The third layer is the season: the spring flood and summer heat of Khwarazm dictated when war could be fought, and in late autumn and early winter, when the water dropped and the ground hardened, cavalry could ride out; the climax of the suppression fell in that part of the year, while the insurgents used the slack agricultural months to replace men and animals. In the end this was a war of terrain and communal mobilisation against order and machines, and the government won by sealing the waterways, clearing the strongholds one by one and removing the insurgents' leadership, squeezing a guerrilla movement that depended on the water network into a handful of fixed points.
data: 可核的數字首先是系年：起義繫於公元八六六年，此後延續數年；八七〇年巴士拉的伊巴德派領袖阿布·貝克爾·伊本·哈拉勒應召北上並在一次河戰中陣亡，叛亂至此失去核心，鎮壓在八七〇年代之中得告完成。編年所給的月份沒有任何記載，卡面標出的四月是依春季徵作與春汛前後的邊務季節推得，屬於推定而非記載。距離與位置可以查核：花剌子模河三角洲位於鹹海東南岸，主要城邑卡茲（Kāt，即今別魯尼一帶）距鹹海岸約六十餘公里，運河總幹自河口向內陸分出數十公里，逐塊灌溉的三角洲耕地是叛方在封鎖下仍能自給的地方；由此往撒馬爾罕約七百公里，沿驛道至巴格達約一千六百至一千八百公里。第三類數字是體制的量級：阿弗拉西亞比德家族自八二〇年前後入主花剌子模，至九九九年被馬穆尼德取代，前後約一百七十年；總督府常備軍的規模沒有留下可核的數字，通常以「數千騎兵與若干步兵營」形容；叛方全無總數，編年只提到若干城鎮的民眾參與，最後被處置者寥寥。兵員、攻城器械數量與雙方的具體損耗今天都無法核實，任何精確的傷亡數字都應視為後世推想。唯一可以確定的軍備數據是兵器本身的形制與長度：卡面長矛的杆長約兩米，這一數值在拜占庭與伊斯蘭世界的步兵矛技術中反覆出現。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked come first of all from the chronology: the revolt is dated to 866 CE and ran on for several years; in 870 Abu Bakr ibn al-Khallal, the Ibadi leader of Basra, was summoned north and was killed in a river battle, the movement lost its centre, and the suppression was complete sometime in the course of the 870s. No chronicle gives a month, so the April on the card is an inference from the spring levying season and the timing of the flood, not a record. Distances and positions can be checked: the Khwarazm delta lies on the south-eastern shore of the Aral, the principal town of Kath (Kāt, in the neighbourhood of modern Beruni) stands some sixty kilometres or so from the water, and the main canals run tens of kilometres inland from the mouth, the block-irrigated delta fields being the place from which the insurgents could still feed themselves under blockade. From there it is about seven hundred kilometres to Samarkand and some sixteen to eighteen hundred kilometres by the caravan road to Baghdad. The third class of numbers concerns the scale of institutions: the Afrasiabid family took Khwarazm from about 820 and was replaced by the Maʾmunids in 999, a run of roughly a hundred and seventy years. No verifiable figure survives for the size of the governorate's standing army, which is usually described in the sources only as some thousands of cavalry and a number of infantry camps; the insurgents have no total at all, the chronicles speak only of the participation of the inhabitants of certain towns, and those finally executed were few. Numbers of men, of siege machines and of losses on both sides cannot be recovered today, and any exact casualty figure should be treated as later reconstruction. The one hard piece of ordnance data is the form and length of the weapon itself: the shaft of the spear on the card is about two metres, and that figure recurs throughout Byzantine and Islamic infantry spear technology.
cause: 起義的成因要分遠因與近因。遠因是花剌子模的宗教結構：三角洲的波斯裔居民在八、九世紀間大批改宗，伊巴德派在這裡不是被容忍的異端，而是許多家戶的日常信仰；總督府是阿拉伯裔的世襲軍人政權，與中央哈里發一道推動遜尼派正統化，使伊巴德派在稅制、任官與集會上逐漸被擠到邊緣。哈瓦利吉派教義中「除了真主別無仲裁」的主張，又使伊巴德派天然適合以小社群的方式在異教王公之間尋求庇護與自治；這種做法在北非的伊馬目國與地中海的澤爾巴島早已運作成熟，花剌子模的伊巴德社群沿同一邏輯尋求自身的安全。近因是九世紀六十年代的中央崩解：八六一年起薩馬拉陷入無政府狀態，哈里發與禁軍爭權，欠餉引發兵變，前線總督的軍費與生計都被上游抽走，這正是邊區容易生事的結構條件；在花剌子模，總督安努什爾萬一面要向巴格達證明自己仍控制邊區，一面要在地方上推行對伊巴德社群的清算，兩股壓力同時落在同一批人身上。此外還有邊疆競爭的暗流：喀什一側的薩馬尼王朝本身以伊巴德派起家，其奠基者努赫·伊本·曼蘇爾原屬伊巴德派，後來改宗；花剌子模與之接壤，雙方在定居者、逃戶與商路上互有爭奪。直接引信則是具體的行政事件：殘存編年把起義的爆發繫於總督府對伊巴德社群的拘押、徵稅與搜查，確切日期無從考訂，但性質明確——先是逼迫，後是起兵。
causeEn: The causes divide into remote and immediate. The remote cause was the religious structure of Khwarazm: Persian-speaking inhabitants of the delta converted in bulk during the eighth and ninth centuries, and here the Ibadi doctrine was not a tolerated heresy but the daily faith of many households, while the governorate was a hereditary Arab military regime which, together with the caliph in Baghdad, pushed Sunni orthodoxy, squeezing the Ibadi out of taxation, office and public assembly. The Kharijite principle that there is no judge but God also made the Ibadi naturally inclined to seek protection and autonomy as small communities among rulers of different faiths; that pattern had already worked for centuries in the Ibadi imamate of Tahert and on the island of Djerba, and the Ibadi of Khwarazm were following the same logic in seeking their own security. The immediate cause was the collapse of the centre in the 860s: from 861 Samarra was in a state of anarchy, caliphs and guards fought over power, unpaid soldiers mutinied, and the frontier governor lost money and men to the upstream, which is exactly the structural condition under which border provinces become turbulent. In Khwarazm the governor Anushirvan had to show Baghdad that he still held the frontier, while at the same time pressing a purge on the Ibadi communities at home, and both pressures fell on the same people. Beneath this ran the friction of frontier rivalry: the Samanid state on the Khurasan side had itself risen among the Ibadi, its founder Nuh ibn Mansur having been an Ibadi before converting, and Khwarazm bordered it, the two competing for settlers, runaways and trade. The immediate spark was a concrete administrative event: the surviving chronicle ties the outbreak to arrests, tax demands and searches carried out against the Ibadi communities by the governorate. The exact date cannot be established, but the nature of it is plain — pressure first, rising in arms afterwards.
impact: 鎮壓成功的第一層後果是花剌子模伊巴德派公共存在的被打斷：清真寺的合法地位、伊巴德派法官的裁判權、宣教網絡的節點都被拆散或轉入地下，往後數百年，這一地區在伊斯蘭史上不再出現成形的哈瓦利吉派政體，鹹海東岸成為遜尼派世界與波斯文化交會的前線，而哈瓦利吉派在伊斯蘭世界的存續，主要只剩下北非的伊巴德社群與澤爾巴島的自治。第二層後果是阿弗拉西亞比德家族的坐大：他們在鎮壓起義中鞏固了對花剌子模的實際控制，軍事與財政的自主性隨之上升；八七三年薩馬尼王朝的內菲魯二世出兵吞併花剌子模，總督府降為薩曼尼的附庸，卻也因此在九八〇年代末為馬穆尼德所取代。可以說，八六六年的鎮壓保住的是總督府一時的權位，並沒有改變花剌子模作為一個獨立政權終將被兼併的走向。第三層後果屬於思想史：伊巴德派在花剌子模的失敗，與同時段北非伊巴德派在納富薩山的處境一起，說明在九世紀末的伊斯蘭世界，哈瓦利吉派已從建國的選項退守為地方信仰；此後一千年裡，哈瓦利吉派留下的制度遺產——選舉式領袖、社區互助、拒絕向不信者繳稅——主要以伊巴德派村落自治的形式在馬格里布與撒哈拉邊緣延續。軍史層面上，這場戰爭再次呈現了阿拔斯前沿省的典型模式：中央缺位，地方總督以自己的軍隊平亂，叛方敗於封鎖與清剿，而不是敗於一場會戰。
impactEn: The first consequence of the successful suppression was the destruction of the public presence of the Ibadi in Khwarazm: the legal standing of their mosques, the jurisdiction of their qadis and the nodes of their preaching networks were broken up or driven underground, and for centuries afterwards no formed Kharijite polity appeared in this region; the eastern shore of the Aral became a frontier where the Sunni world met Persian culture, and the survival of the Kharijite in the Islamic world came to rest mainly with the Ibadi communities of North Africa and the autonomy of Djerba. The second consequence was the aggrandisement of the Afrasiabid family: consolidating their real control of Khwarazm through the suppression, they acquired a growing military and fiscal autonomy; in 873 Nasir II of the Samanids conquered Khwarazm and the governorate sank to being a Samanid vassal, only to be replaced by the Maʾmunids at the end of the 980s. In this sense the suppression of 866 saved the governorate its position for a while and did nothing to change the fact that Khwarazm, as an independent polity, was eventually to be absorbed. The third consequence belongs to the history of ideas: the defeat of the Ibadi in Khwarazm, together with the situation of the Ibadi in the Nafusa mountains of North Africa in the same decades, shows that by the end of the ninth century the Kharijite had retreated from being a candidate for statehood to being a local faith; over the following millennium the institutional legacy of the Kharijite — elected leaders, communal mutual aid, refusal to pay tribute to those judged unbelievers — survived chiefly in the form of Ibadi village autonomy along the Maghrib and the edges of the Sahara. At the level of military history the war again displayed the classic pattern of the Abbasid frontier provinces: the centre absent, the local governor settling the rising with his own troops, and the insurgents defeated by blockade and clearance rather than by a pitched battle.
result: 結果是起義被鎮壓，總督府保住了花剌子模。八七〇年阿布·貝克爾·伊本·哈拉勒在河戰中陣亡，叛方的精神與組織核心隨之瓦解；餘部失去旗幄與協調者，或散回村社，或被收編為總督府的附屬民兵與邊軍，數年間零星抵抗，至八七〇年代中後期基本平定。這場戰爭的具體戰果不能按現代戰役的樣式統計：攻城若干、斬首若干、俘獲若干的數字散佚於殘卷，無從核實；能確定的結果有三項：一，花剌子模河三角洲的城邑與運河重新回到總督府的直接控制；二，伊巴德派在花剌子模的公共存在被清除，宣教與司法機構轉入地下或消失；三，阿弗拉西亞比德家族以鎮壓邊亂的功績，繼續在阿拔斯體制內擴張自身實力，最終把花剌子模經營成一個獨立的波斯化政權，至九九九年為馬穆尼德所取代。對卡面這件兵器而言，斯巴達長矛並沒有出現在花剌子模的戰場；它在這裡的意義是提供了一個技術起點的標尺——以木杆、鐵鏃與尾套構成的兩米長矛，自希臘方陣一路傳到拜占庭的持矛兵與伊斯蘭世界的步兵手中，其形制在九世紀的運河村社裡仍以最樸素的方式被複製，而正是靠這類長矛結成的步兵方陣，讓總督軍在逐堡清剿中能夠把失去水網依托的叛軍逐次吃掉。
resultEn: The rising was suppressed and the governorate kept Khwarazm. In 870 Abu Bakr ibn al-Khallal was killed in the river battle and the spiritual and organisational core of the revolt broke apart with him; the remnants, deprived of a banner and a coordinator, either scattered back to their villages or were taken into the governorate's auxiliary militia and frontier levies, and resistance flickered on for a few years before being effectively over by the middle and later 870s. The score of this war cannot be counted in the modern manner: the numbers of towns taken, heads struck off and prisoners taken survive only in fragments and cannot be verified. Three outcomes can be stated with confidence. First, the towns and canals of the Khwarazm delta returned to the governorate's direct control. Second, the public presence of the Ibadi in Khwarazm was removed, and its preaching and judicial institutions went underground or disappeared. Third, the Afrasiabid family, on the strength of having suppressed a frontier rising, went on expanding its own power within the Abbasid system until Khwarazm had become an independent Persianate polity, replaced by the Maʾmunids in 999. As for the weapon on the card, the Dory never fought in Khwarazm; what it does here is supply a yardstick for a technical starting point. A two-metre spear built of a wooden shaft, an iron head and a metal butt socket passed from the Greek phalanx to the Byzantine pikemen and to the infantry of the Islamic world, and in the ninth-century canal villages its form was still reproduced in the plainest possible way. It was precisely the phalanx of pikes of this kind that let the governor's troops, in clearing the strongholds one after another, eat up an insurgency that had lost the support of the waterways.
